first.title: Collect the books on this page
first.request: Collect the book titles and prices on this page
first.expected: The 4 books on the first page: Between Mountains and Seas, ¥32.00; City Strolls, ¥45.00; Room to Breathe, ¥39.00; Moonlight on the Page, ¥28.50.

pagination.title: Collect the first two pages of books
pagination.request: Collect the book titles and prices from the first two pages
pagination.expected: 8 different books. The first book on page 2 is Little Maps for the Journey, ¥48.00.

detail.title: Collect book details
detail.request: Open the first two books and collect their titles and descriptions.
detail.expected: 2 books. The description of Between Mountains and Seas mentions journeys and homecomings; City Strolls mentions walking through city streets.

search.title: Search first, then collect the results
search.request: Search for “City” and collect the matching book titles and prices

file-list.title: Collect books from an uploaded list
file-list.request: Use my uploaded list. Open each link in the “URL” column and collect the book title and price.
file-list.expected: The 2 books in the list: Between Mountains and Seas, ¥32.00; City Strolls, ¥45.00. Each source URL must match the book on that row.

scroll.title: Collect reviews loaded by scrolling
scroll.request: Collect each review, including the reviewer, rating, and review text
scroll.expected: 12 different reviews. The first reviewer is Lin Xiao; the last is Yu He.

more.title: Collect reviews with Load more
more.request: Collect all reviews, including the reviewer, rating, and review text.
more.expected: 12 different reviews. The first reviewer is Lin Xiao; the last is Yu He.

wait.title: Wait for orders, then collect them
wait.request: Click “Start loading orders” and collect the order number, product, and amount when they appear.
wait.expected: 4 orders. The first is DD1001, Between Mountains and Seas, ¥32.00.

form.title: Fill in and submit the practice form
form.request: Submit an order inquiry for Lin. Choose an on-site message and urgent handling, and enter “I would like an update on my order.”
form.expected: The page shows “Practice submission successful”. Name: Lin; topic: Order inquiry; reply: On-site message; urgent handling selected; message: I would like an update on my order.

hover.title: Collect contact details revealed on hover
hover.request: Find the bookshop support contact details and collect the email address and phone number.

dialog.title: Collect an order from a dialog
dialog.request: Open the order details, collect the order number, product, and amount, then close the dialog.
dialog.expected: 1 order: DD3001, Between Mountains and Seas, ¥32.00. The dialog is closed after the run.

frame.title: Collect orders from an embedded page
frame.request: Collect the order number, product, and amount from the embedded order table.
frame.expected: 3 orders. Check each order number, product, and amount against the embedded table.

api.title: Collect orders from a web API
api.request: Click “Load orders” and collect the order number, product name, and amount from the API.
api.expected: 4 orders. The first is DD1001, Between Mountains and Seas, ¥32.00. Also check that the task uses the data loaded by the page.

send.title: Send a sample order and check the response
send.request: Send the sample order on this page to https://httpbin.org/post, then save the returned order number, product, and amount as a table.
send.expected: The returned order number, product, and amount match the sample on the page. This sends fictional data to a real third-party test service.

tidy.title: Filter and format the collected results
tidy.request: Collect the titles and prices of books over ¥35 on the first page. Use English column names and save the results to a separate new table.
tidy.expected: 2 books: City Strolls, ¥45.00; Room to Breathe, ¥39.00. Both columns have English names.

contacts.title: Extract emails, phone numbers, and images
contacts.expected: 3 different email addresses, 2 practice phone numbers with country codes, and the 2 sample images on the page.
